theater: 晉陽城與馬邑塞外草原

battle.name: 李淵擊突厥之戰
battle.theater: 晉陽城與馬邑塞外草原
battle.brief: 大業十二年（616），三次征高句麗之後，隋廷力竭而群盜蜂起，突厥趁太原守備空虛南下。太原留守李淵率精騎出塞邀擊，於馬邑、樓煩一帶破敵，突厥引去，晉陽得全。卡面羅馬弩砲屬公元前五十年，此役並無一字記載，但它那「以整組人力拆牆」的辦法，正是李淵翌年巢車攻城時的另一條譜系。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 大業十二年（616），交戰的一方是隋朝的河東邊軍，主力是太原留守李淵以太原留守府與河東郡的編制所部，兵源兼有府兵、邊軍與臨時招募的鄉兵，駐防重點是晉陽城與周邊烽堧，馬匹來自汾晉牧地與西北馬市；另一方是東突厥汗庭，616年時汗位在頗利可汗手中，帳下分為數十支部眾，以阿史那氏為核心，以游騎掠邊、驅擄人畜為主要收益。隋朝在這一役仍握有正統名分與糧餉通道，但主力兵已被三次征高句麗與平定地方叛亂消耗，實際能投入河東的只是太原一處的守軍與附近各縣的團練。突厥則完全沒有攻城的打算，也不打正面會戰：他們要的只是越過邊塞、奪取糧秣與人畜，再退回草原。兩軍的接觸因此只發生在邊緣地帶，規模有限而節奏很快，這也正是史冊對這場戰爭著墨極少的原因。
countriesEn: The two sides in 616 were, on one side, the Sui frontier army of Hedong, whose main body was the force Li Yuan commanded in his capacity as keeper of Taiyuan and at the same time as governor of the Hedong commandery, drawn from the fubing, the frontier levies and hastily raised local militia, with the garrison concentrated on the city of Jinyang and the beacon towers around it, and with warhorses from the pastures of the Fen and Jin valleys and from the horse markets of the northwest; on the other side stood the Eastern Turkic khaganate, the khanate in 616 being held by Khagan Jieli, whose following was divided into several dozen tribal contingents centred on the Ashina clan, whose main profit came from sweeping the frontier and taking people and livestock as captives. The Sui still held the formal legitimacy and the grain route in this campaign, but its best troops had been drained by three campaigns against Goguryeo and by the suppression of local rebellions, so the only force that could genuinely be committed at Hedong was the garrison of one city together with the local militia of the counties around it. The Turks had no thought of storming walls and fought no general engagement: all they wanted was to cross the frontier, seize grain and livestock, and fall back to the steppe. Contact between the two armies therefore took place only along the margins, small in scale and quick in rhythm, and that is exactly why the historical record has so little to say about this war.
people: 此役真正決定局面的是李淵。他是太原留守，同時行河東郡守與總管府事，是隋廷放在北方防線上的一枚棋子，也是日後唐朝的開國皇帝；早年募兵起家的他，到616年已在太原經營多年，招募的部曲與蓄積的馬匹是他真正的本錢。隨軍的次子李世民時年未及二十，尚在太原府充任屬吏，隨父理事，據其後來自述，他自幼與羣兒游戲於營中便已習兵陣之事，日後受命募兵、掌理軍籍，才逐漸顯出用兵之才——這份起步正是在太原這幾年累積而成。隋廷方面的關鍵人物是煬帝楊廣：他北巡柳城、募兵備邊，卻把太原的守備抽空，正是這次突厥入寇得以深入的直接原因；同年七月他在中原方面的精銳也遭重創，張須陀戰死於滎汜水，中原與北邊同時失血。突厥方面的核心是頗利可汗，他整合了前可汗留下的諸部，恢復了對漠南的指揮，並在數年後樂於扶植中原的邊地武人作為代理人。器械的源頭還有一個遙遠的身影：羅馬的維特魯威烏斯在《建築十書》第十卷留下弩砲的形制與扭力尺寸，是這件卡面兵器最完整的技術記錄。
peopleEn: The man who decided the outcome was Li Yuan. He was keeper of Taiyuan and at the same time governor of Hedong and head of the general affairs of the commandery: the piece the Sui court had set on the northern line, and the man who would later become the founding emperor of the Tang. Having raised troops as a young man, he had spent years building himself a position at Taiyuan by 616, and the retainers he had recruited and the horses he had gathered were his real capital. His second son Li Shimin was not yet twenty and still served as a clerk in the offices of Taiyuan, assisting his father; by his own later account he had already practised the drill of the camp while playing with the boys of the garrison, and it was only when he was given the task of recruiting troops and keeping the muster rolls that his talent for command began to show - and that start had been built in the years spent at Taiyuan. The decisive figure on the Sui side was Emperor Yang of Sui, Yang Guang: he toured the north to Liucheng and mustered troops for the frontier, yet in doing so emptied Taiyuan of its defenders, and that was the direct reason the Turkic incursion could penetrate so deep; in the same year his best troops in the central plains were gutted as well, Zhang Xuetuo falling at the Yingsi river in July, so that the centre and the north bled at once. The core figure on the Turkic side was Khagan Jieli, who had welded together the tribes left behind by his predecessors, restored the khanate's command over the southern steppe, and a few years later was glad to back border rebels in the Central Plains as his proxies. At the far end of the weapon's genealogy stands one more name: Vitruvius, who left the shape and the torsion dimensions of the bolt-thrower in the tenth book of De Architectura, the fullest technical record of the weapon shown on this card.
kits: 卡面那件羅馬弩砲（Scorpio）並不在616年的河東戰場上，它的技術年代是公元前五十年，離此役六百六十六年。但它值得細說：羅馬弩砲以木製機身、兩束扭力索（以髮、筋或麻纖維纏成）、金屬滑槽與一具長約一公尺的粗箭組成，發射時靠整組人馬上弦、定向、放手，一發只出一具箭，射完還要把滑槽重新絞回原位。它的厲害不在射程，而在把「攻城」從圍困變成拆牆，使羅馬能逐城攻破希臘城邦的防禦體系。中國那邊，同期的對應物是床弩與蹶張弩：同樣靠人力把巨大的簧力壓進機括，同樣是整組人操作的、射速極慢的投射兵器，同樣用來對付城牆與城樓。李淵自己在617年攻霍邑時所造的巢車，與這條譜系更近：把射擊、掩護與登城合為一體的攻城器械，把攻城從「餓死對方」變成「當場破城」。這條路徑的完整版本出現在617年末的長安：步騎大軍、巢車與雲梯同時壓上，一座隋朝依託關中形勝與城防厚度守了百年的都城被打破——同一種拆牆技術，這次服務的對象換成了隋朝本身。而616年的河東戰場本身是純粹的騎兵戰：隋軍用蹶張弩與臂弩遠射，槊與大盾結陣，拒馬槊與拒鹿角擋住衝鋒，靠從西北馬市買來的良馬與替馬維持追擊；突厥以角弓與筋弓、骨鏃、標槍、鑲骨皮甲、氈帳、駱駝馱載的帳篷與乳酪風乾肉作戰，完全是另一套草原裝備。
kitsEn: The Roman bolt-thrower on this card was not on the Hedong battlefield of 616; its technical date is 50 BC, six hundred and sixty-six years before the campaign. It is still worth describing in detail. The scorpio consisted of a wooden frame, two bundles of torsion (hair, sinew or hemp cord wound together), a metal slider and a single heavy bolt about a metre long. Firing required a crew to cock the machine, lay it and release it; it shot one bolt at a time, and after the shot the slider had to be wound back into position. Its power lay not in range but in turning siege from blockade into breaching: it let Rome break Greek city walls one by one and dismantle the defensive system of the Greek city-states. On the Chinese side the contemporary equivalents were the bed crossbow and the tensioned draw crossbow: the same principle of men bodily storing enormous spring force in the mechanism, the same crew-served projectile weapon of very slow rate of fire, the same answer to walls and gate towers. The siege tower Li Yuan built against Huyang in 617 stands even closer to that lineage, for it fused shooting, cover and climbing into a single machine and turned siege from starving the enemy into breaking the city on the spot. The full version of that path arrived at Chang'an in the last months of 617, when a combined host of foot and horse pressed up with siege towers and scaling ladders and a capital that had stood for a century on the strength of the Guanzhong position and the thickness of its walls was opened: the same technology of breaking walls, this time serving the Sui itself. The Hedong field of 616 was in truth a pure cavalry battle. The Sui shot with tensioned and arm crossbows, closed with spears and large shields, planted juma spears and deer-horn obstacles to stop the charge, and sustained the pursuit with fine horses and remounts bought at the horse markets of the northwest. The Turks fought with composite bows of horn and sinew, bone and iron arrowheads, long javelins, studded leather armour, felt tents, camel-borne tent poles and dried cheese and dried meat: an entirely different equipment system of the steppe.
tactics: 616年的對抗在技術上是一場「不打野戰」的較量。李淵沒有選擇離開晉陽去草原上追擊，而是把城塞當作支點：先以斥候巡塞，探明突厥部眾的數量、進犯方向與草場水泉的位置，然後把精騎集結在城外的近距地域，分派部將據守通往馬邑、樓煩的隘口，使敵軍無法貼著城牆進攻；一旦突厥主力逼近，隋軍先以弩的齊射打散其前鋒，再以兩翼騎兵從側面衝擊，把戰場限制在城牆與隘口之間可覆蓋的方圓之內。追擊則刻意留有分寸：兵不深入草莽，不與突厥比耐力，只在敵人掉頭回竄、隊形散開時咬住不放，切斷其退往塞內的通道，逼其退回草原。突厥的作法與之相反：不攻城、不戀戰、不接戰，以三五成群的游騎四出偵探與掠奪，逼近城塞以引隋軍出城，待隋軍離開城牆的掩護範圍，才在有利地形上短兵相接；得手即帶著人畜與牲畜轉身就走。這套「不打硬仗」的草原邏輯，後來在劉武周身上重演：突厥人扶植代理人出兵，兵卒與糧秣由自己供應，自己卻始終不把主力押在中原的城垣上。對比之下，羅馬弩砲那一套正好是反面：它讓羅馬人把戰場搬到城牆邊上，用一發一具箭的遲緩節奏去拆掉希臘人的城，而草原騎兵寧可永遠不進攻城。
tacticsEn: Technically, the contest of 616 was a battle fought on the principle of not fighting a general action. Li Yuan chose not to leave Jinyang and chase the Turks across the steppe; he used the fortress as his fulcrum. First the outriders patrolled the frontier to learn the number of Turkic columns, the direction of the incursion and the position of pasture and water; then he massed his best horse inside the immediate approaches outside the walls and posted commanders to hold the passes leading to Mayi and Loufan, so that the enemy could not hug the ramparts and work on the city. When the Turkic main body came up, the Sui opened with massed crossbow fire to scatter the vanguard, then sent horse from the two flanks into the sides, holding the battlefield inside the envelope covered by the walls and the passes. The pursuit was deliberately measured: no deep thrust into the grassland, no attempt to outlast the Turks on their own ground. They only hung on when the enemy turned and its order dissolved, cutting the road back inside the frontier and forcing it back to the steppe. The Turkic method was the opposite: no siege, no lingering, no engagement. Skirmishers in threes and fives roved the border, scouting and taking booty, coming close to the forts to draw the Sui out, and only closing to short weapon range on favourable ground once the Sui had left the cover of their walls; on success they turned away at once with the people, grain and animals they had taken. This steppe logic of never fighting a hard fight was repeated later in the person of Liu Wuzhou: the Turks put a proxy in the field, supplied the men and the grain themselves, and never committed their main force to the cities of the Central Plains. The Roman bolt-thrower stands as the exact reverse of all this: it allowed Rome to move the battle to the foot of the wall and to dismantle a Greek city at the deliberate pace of one bolt at a time, while the steppe horseman would rather never enter a city at all.
data: 這場戰爭留下來的數字很少，能夠確定的多在時間與距離上。時間：事在隋煬帝大業十二年（616），史冊未記確月（本卡取夏秋之交），同年正月煬帝在柳城一帶大募兵備，賞格開得極高；二月王薄起於長白山，七月張須陀在滎汜水戰死，隋廷的中原精銳在同一年被前後兩個方向同時消耗，年底已無一支可隨意調動的大軍。距離：自晉陽向北三四百里，即是馬邑、樓煩一帶的塞外草場，那正是突厥騎兵越塞後展開的地帶；再往北便是陰山與長城舊線。李淵的兵力沒有留下確數，只能說是「以精騎出塞」的數千之眾，其中可用來輪替的替馬數量決定了追擊的極限。器械的數字反倒在別處留下記錄：羅馬弩砲的箭長約一公尺、配鐵鏃，發射後需整組人馬把滑槽絞回，一發一具箭；中國的床弩與之同類，記錄中的弩矢射程從數百步到千步不等，兩者都是「射速極慢、必須整組操作」的投射兵器。數字之外還有一組可對照的年份：弩砲的技術年代在公元前五十年，距616年六百六十六年；隋朝自開皇年間在靈州、朔州修築的邊城與屯田，至此已運轉五十餘年，那正是李淵此役可以「以城為依托」的前提。
dataEn: This war left very few numbers behind, and what can be fixed lies mostly in time and distance. On time: the affair belongs to the twelfth year of Daye (616) under Emperor Yang, and the chronicles do not record the exact month (this card takes the turn of summer and autumn). In the first month of that year the emperor mustered troops on a large scale around Liucheng, with rewards posted at an extremely high rate; in the second month Wang Bo rose in the Changbai mountains; in the seventh month Zhang Xuetuo fell at the Yingsi river. The Sui's central-plains troops were being drained in two directions within the same year, and by the end of it there remained no army that could be moved at will. On distance: three or four hundred li north of Jinyang lies the steppe pasture of the Mayi and Loufan country, which is precisely the ground the Turkic horsemen opened up after crossing the frontier, and further north stand the Yinshan and the old line of the Great Wall. No exact figure survives for Li Yuan's force; it can only be said that he took some thousands of picked horse out beyond the wall, and that the number of remounts available for rotation set the limit of how far the pursuit could go. The numbers for the weapons survive elsewhere. The Roman bolt was about a metre long with an iron head, and after firing the crew had to wind the slider back: one bolt at a time. The Chinese bed crossbow is of the same kind, with recorded bolt ranges running from several hundred paces to a thousand, and both belong to the family of projectile weapons that are slow to shoot and must be worked by a whole crew. Beyond the numbers there is a second set of dates worth setting side by side: the technical date of the bolt-thrower is 50 BC, six hundred and sixty-six years before 616; and the frontier towns and military farms that the Sui had built at Lingzhou and Shuozhou since the Kaihuang era had by now been running for more than fifty years, which is the premise that allowed Li Yuan to fight this campaign with the city as his anchor.
cause: 要理解616年為什麼會打起來，得看隋朝同時在燒的幾把火。第一是三次征高句麗。610年至614年，隋煬帝傾全國之兵東征，士卒死亡以數十萬計，戶口銳減，府兵制賴以為基礎的均田農戶大量脫籍，河北、江南的人力與糧食被抽調一空。第二是民間變亂。616年二月王薄起於長白山，同年七月瓦崗軍在滎汜水重創張須陀所部，河北則有竇建德收拾潰兵與流民，地方上能打仗的軍事力量不再聽中央調度。第三是北方。始畢可汗死後，汗庭經處羅可汗、頗利可汗兩度易主，到616年可汗已經能整頓諸部，恢復對漠南的號令；草原上的強者向內整合完畢，就會轉向外擴，而隋朝邊防的縱深幾乎全靠靈州、朔州、太原幾個點狀城塞與一道年久失修的長城線，點與點之間的空隙正是騎兵最愛走的路。第四是體制。隋朝用「有邊才有效率」的思路治理邊鎮，中央卻把精銳派去遙遠的東北與江南，留在河東的只有守軍與糧秣。這四把火同時燒起，616年的突厥南下其實只是最先燒到的那一根引線。
causeEn: To understand why there was a war in 616, one has to look at the fires the Sui was burning at the same time. The first was the three campaigns against Goguryeo. Between 610 and 614 Emperor Yang of Sui threw the strength of the whole empire eastward; the dead were counted in hundreds of thousands, the households thinned out, and the equal-field peasantry on which the fubing system rested left the registers in great numbers, while the manpower and grain of Hebei and of Jiangnan were drawn away to the last. The second was revolt in the interior. In the second month of 616 Wang Bo rose in the Changbai mountains; in the seventh month the Wagang forces mauled Zhang Xuetuo's command at the Yingsi river; in Hebei Dou Jiande gathered the broken soldiers and the runaway peasants. The local military force of the realm no longer answered to the centre. The third was the north. After the death of Shebi Khagan the khanate changed hands twice more, through Qimin and Jieli, and by 616 the khan could already discipline the tribes and restore his command over the southern steppe; a power that has finished integrating inward turns outward. The Sui's frontier depth rested almost entirely on a few point strongholds at Lingzhou, Shuozhou and Taiyuan and on a long wall line that had been out of repair for years, and the gaps between the points were exactly the road the horsemen preferred. The fourth was the system itself. The Sui ran its frontier towns on the reasoning that a frontier only worked if it was properly supplied, yet the centre sent its best troops to the far northeast and to the south, leaving at Hedong nothing but garrisons and grain. With these four fires burning at once, the Turkic move south in 616 was only the fuse that happened to catch first.
impact: 短期看，這場戰爭救下了太原，也成就了李淵。擊退突厥之後，李淵在太原的地位更加鞏固，招募的部曲、買到的戰馬、訓練出來的騎兵成為他個人的本錢；大業十三年（617）他起兵時能用兵數萬而迅速南下，其中相當一部分就是這幾年以守土之名累積下來的。三個月後他兵臨長安，用巢車與雲梯打下隋朝的都城——這是616年那次邊境勝利最直接的延伸：一支在太原練成的、能攻能騎的軍隊，最後成了覆蓋隋朝的軍隊。對突厥而言，這一仗則證明在隋朝內亂之際南進並不容易，於是把重心轉向扶植代理人：數年後劉武周以馬邑為基地起兵，突厥以兵眾與馬匹相助，一度攻陷太原，逼得唐太宗李世民親自率軍北上，在井陘與柏壁一線苦戰數月才收回失地；李唐因此在開國之初就消耗了一大批最精銳的騎兵。中期看，隋唐兩朝最終選擇了同一條路：保留城塞與屯田的「守牆」體系，同時發展能破牆的投射兵器與攻城器械，把防守與進攻兩套技術一起帶到漠北，最終在貞觀三年（629）李靖夜襲定襄、貞觀四年（630）頗利可汗被擒時集中爆發。長期看，草原與中原的角力不再靠一場會戰定勝負，而是靠誰能年年供養一支既能守城、又能遠征的軍隊——正是這場戰爭展示的東西。
impactEn: In the short term the war saved Taiyuan and it made Li Yuan. After the Turks were driven off, his position at Taiyuan grew more secure, and the retainers he had recruited, the horses he had bought and the cavalry he had trained became his own capital; when he raised his banner in the thirteenth year of Daye (617) he could bring tens of thousands of men south quickly, and a good part of them had been accumulated in those years under the name of defending the soil. Three months later he stood before Chang'an and took the Sui capital with siege towers and scaling ladders - the most direct extension of that border victory of 616: an army trained at Taiyuan that could both ride and besiege ended up burying the Sui. For the Turks the lesson was that moving south into a Sui consumed by civil war was not easy, so they turned to supporting proxies instead. A few years later Liu Wuzhou rose at Mayi with Turkic soldiers and horses, took Taiyuan, and forced Emperor Taizong Li Shimin to march north in person; only after months of hard fighting along the Jingxing and Bole lines was the lost ground recovered, and the newborn Tang spent a large part of its finest cavalry in the process. In the medium term the Sui and the Tang finally chose the same road: keeping the wall system of forts and military farms while developing the projectile weapons and siege machines that could break walls, carrying both the defensive and the offensive technologies north into the desert, where they came together in the third year of Zhenguan (629) with Li Jing's night attack on Dingxiang and in 630 with the capture of Khagan Jieli. In the long term, the contest between the steppe and the Central Plains was no longer settled by a single battle but by who could feed, year after year, an army able both to hold a city and to campaign far away - which is precisely what this war displayed.
result: 結果很簡單，也很殘酷：突厥沒有攻下晉陽，前鋒被擊退，部眾引回漠北，河東邊境在616年之後一度安定下來。李淵保住了太原，也保住了自己在隋朝的位置，並且在守住城市的同時擴充了兵馬；對隋廷而言，這是一場邊境上的局部勝利，值得加封與賞賜，卻改變不了整個帝國正在散架的事實。史冊對這場戰爭記載稀少，能確定的只有：616年，突厥入寇太原，李淵出擊破之，突厥去。此外便是後來看得見的東西——三年之後，正是這支在太原練成的軍隊，在巢車與雲梯下面打開了長安；而在更早的年代，羅馬人用弩砲拆掉希臘城牆時所確立的「攻城技術決定城邦命運」的道理，也在隋朝身上重演了一次，只是這次執行拆城的不是外來的工程兵，而是一個已經在邊境上贏過一場的守將。把兩件事並排放在一起看，616年的河東草原其實是唐王朝的起跑線：羅馬弩砲從來沒有出現在這片草原上，但它所提醒的東西——砲與器械是「攻城」與「守城」時代的分水嶺——卻在李淵手裡變成了現實。
resultEn: The outcome was simple and hard: the Turks did not take Jinyang, their vanguard was beaten back, the columns withdrew north to the desert, and the Hedong frontier was quiet for a time after 616. Li Yuan had saved Taiyuan and his own standing in the Sui, and he had enlarged his forces while holding the city. For the Sui court this was a local victory on the frontier, worth an honorary title and a reward, but it could not change the fact that the empire was coming apart. The record of this war is thin, and what can be fixed is this: in 616 the Turks invaded Taiyuan, Li Yuan marched out and beat them, and the Turks withdrew. What can be seen afterwards is everything else. Three years later it was precisely the army trained at Taiyuan that opened Chang'an beneath siege towers and scaling ladders. And in an earlier age, when Rome used the bolt-thrower to break down Greek city walls, the principle established there - that the technology of siege decides the fate of a city-state - was reenacted on the Sui, except that the engineers who did the breaking this time were not foreigners but a frontier commander who had already won a battle. Set the two side by side and the steppe country of Hedong in 616 turns out to be the starting line of the Tang dynasty. The Roman bolt-thrower never appeared on that steppe, but the thing it stood for - that artillery and siege machines are the watershed between an age of besieging and an age of being besieged - became real in Li Yuan's hands.
